outline: 瞭解工程系統中常用數學之原理及應用，內容包含：1.常微分方程式之特殊解法，2.傅立葉(Fourier)級數及轉換，3.矩陣代數，4.偏微分方程式，5.數值方法，6.複變函數。
schedule: 1. Power Series Method  2.Legendre Polynomials 3. Frobenius Method  4.Bessel Functions of the  First Kind  5.Properties  of Bessel Functions  6.Bessel Functions of the Second Kind  7.Sturm-Liouville Problems  8.Orthogonal Eigenfunction Expansions  9.Midterm Exam.  10.Trigonometric Fourier Series  11.Functions of Any Period  12. Half-Range Expansions  13.Complex Fourier Series  14. Fourier Transforms  15.Properties of the Fourier Transforms  16.Partial Differential Equations  17.Complex Analysis  18.Final Exam.
assessment: 1.Attendance and Assignments and Quiz 30%  2. Midterm Exam 30%  3. Final Exam 40%
